name: Allée du Quotidien — étape 18 · friser, siéger, seller
note: Tiered verb place; all six verbs are -er, so they all live on the LEFT cottages (the right side is a low stone wall with hedges, no verbs). Tiers: street (hairdresser curling a lady's hair, boy re-tying his kite string, judge sitting in his tall chair with a jay), balcony (girl in a sash drying out the flower box), upper (cook whose pot foams over as he stirs with a snooker cue), roof (cowboy saddling a rocking horse). Forward = far lane; back = near cobbles.
